Photograph of the white-border [[Dagobah: Yoda's Hut (Revised)]] card published by [[Decipher]]. The Star Wars Collectors Archive credits Duncan Jenkins for the photograph, collection and description.

== Source ==
* Physical white-border face: [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=11076 The Star Wars Collectors Archive], photograph GA08206.JPG by Duncan Jenkins.

== Preparation ==
The 640 × 480-pixel PNG is a crop of the photograph as displayed in the browser's separate image view. Crop rectangle (640, 257, 1280, 737) in the 1920 × 993-pixel screenshot, with right and bottom coordinates exclusive. The crop preserves the displayed photograph's pixels at their original screenshot scale.
